verdict.rationale: Baseten's hosted Model APIs are documented only for language models and LLM chat endpoints. Non-text modalities show up only indirectly: Truss, Baseten's own deployment tool, supports `diffusers` and arbitrary frameworks, so you can deploy and call image-generation or other custom models on dedicated infrastructure on the same platform. missing for 10: hosted vision, audio, or image-generation Model APIs callable without deploying, explicit docs for multimodal inputs or outputs, any vision or audio example, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: Truss lets you serve models with the Baseten Inference Stack as well as deploy models from any open-source framework: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, `transformers`, `diffusers`, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and more.
Deploy an open-source, fine-tuned, or custom model on dedicated GPUs.
Use Model APIs to call supported language models without deploying them.
